note: Which cost centers make up each region, for the regional bundles:
python daily_report_runner_api.py --region Indiana
python monthly_region_report.py Indiana
The API cannot answer this. Cost center appears on employees and in the
Data/Organization division/district/group tree, but a district can span
several cost centers, so which stations are a region is a decision the
operation makes -- like the crew minimums next door, not an observation.
cost_centers is the authority: exact names, matched case-insensitively.
cost_center_patterns is a convenience, matched only where no exact name
does, longest pattern first.
Do NOT rely on the shift profile's state prefix. 'IN-A-SBG-07-19' is an
Indiana ambulance, but 'INDY WC' is Indiana too and carries no prefix,
and 'West Virginia Admin' spans five cost centers. That convention has
already caught out the crew-minimum rules once.
The names below are PLACEHOLDERS. To get the real ones, run:
python monthly_region_report.py --list-cost-centers
which prints every cost center in the accumulated state and appends, and
marks the ones no region currently claims. Any cost center left unclaimed
is reported on every regional run -- a station opened after this file was
written would otherwise vanish from its director's numbers with no sign.
